TL;DR: pattern looks suspicious. I ran correlation across the last 120 days. Findings: 
- We observed three additional trial-topup requests that share the same billing email domain and overlapping IP ranges (staging.checkerboard.ai and dev-checkerboard[.]net).
- Payment meta (card tokenization fingerprint) matches a previously flagged account (acct: CHK-6201) where credits were requested repeatedly then converted to low-usage paid plans.
- Usage distribution shows rapid synthetic-like bursts immediately after each top-up.

I've attached a small CSV (fraud_report_dec18.csv) with the indicators. Recommendation: place CHK-9182 on temporary hold for discretionary credits, request KYC/billing verification (official invoice + gov ID for Carla Gomez), and offer a monitored pilot with a reduced trial top-up ($500) only if they provide the billing proofs. Also set an alert for repeat burst patterns for 30 days.

If leadership wants to be stricter, decline the extra credits and propose a time-limited paid pilot instead.

- Rishi
Risk & Fraud, Redwood Inference
